_comment: SYNTHETIC dry-run fixture for `pnpm discover -- --dry-run`. This is not a
captured API response. Place ids are 'fixture-*' rather than real Places
ids, and rows built from this file are written with source=places-fixture.
Rating and review count are deliberately absent: inventing them would feed
fabricated numbers into the audit score. The audit falls back to a neutral
value multiplier and says so in the report.
KH Machine Works is a real business; only its public name and website are
recorded here, nothing else about it is asserted.
